item.title: GPT-6, Sonnet 5.5, Opus 5.5, Gemini 3 — Which AI Model Should You Use? The October 2026 Complete Selection Guide
item.description:
“Wait — what’s the difference between ChatGPT’s GPT-6 and Claude’s Sonnet 5.5?”

A colleague asked me this the other day, and I couldn’t answer on the spot. “It’s the smarter one” doesn’t cut it as an explanation.

AI is evolving so fast that each company now offers multiple models simultaneously. OpenAI has rebuilt its lineup into a three-tier GPT-6 family (Astra, Sol, Luna). Anthropic now spans four tiers with Fable, Opus, Sonnet, and Haiku. Google splits between Pro and Flash. Model names have nearly been swapped out wholesale since I first wrote this article six months ago. Before you can even “use AI,” you’re stuck deciding which model to use — and that decision keeps getting harder, not easier.
